description: This source file implements a command-line utility for controlling and inspecting a control service via client-server communication. It includes functionality for reloading services and dumping their state, with support for recursive file traversal and verbose output.

classes.name: ControlClient
classes.description: A client class for communicating with a control service, capable of sending reload and dump commands.

methods.name: ControlClient::ControlClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client with a service path and timeout.

methods.name: ControlClient::Reload
methods.description: Sends a reload command to the service.

methods.name: ControlClient::Dump
methods.description: Requests a dump of the service's state and returns it as a string.

methods.name: Usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line utility.

methods.name: ReloadCommand
methods.description: Executes a reload operation on a specified service or all services.

methods.name: DumpCommand
methods.description: Executes a dump operation on a specified service or all services.

methods.name: ReloadCommandCallback
methods.description: Callback for reloading a file if it is a regular file.

methods.name: DumpCommandCallback
methods.description: Callback for dumping a file if it is a regular file.

methods.name: HexDump
methods.description: Outputs a hex and ASCII representation of a memory buffer.
